summary: Narrow the catalogue by category and price
description: The catalogue spans hand tools, power tools and rentals at a wide range of prices. A shopper with a budget and a job in mind needs both filters, and needs them to be honest.
acceptanceCriteria: Filtering by a category returns only products belonging to that category.
Filtering by a price range returns only products priced inside that range, inclusive of both ends.
The catalogue is paginated at 9 products per page.
A product appears on exactly one page of a paginated result, never on two.
Every page of a paginated result reports the same total number of products.
